test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf34888cc54314b5bf4f3b767ef04d850add6485b936e60623d31fec082fa113.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series:

Right corner diagonal elements interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8333b8db786239f08b08fa4c60da66228850fd1559b06cf6cc89cc8686692aaa.png] 

2) Second box series:

Third column element shift clockwise.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/779e8058b16ee76ac5d023cbaec2f74700b7667709e9b4a1a9e1e26af80be648.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cc312ef364af12ab6a5becc706510d7655450ac1b3225bcbf6f29262d2c5dd9.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
